column5: Fort Collins only, recruiting. Surgically removed appendicular OSA, measurable lung-only metastasis, at least 20 kg; chemotherapy washout 2–3 weeks and no steroids or immune-altering medication. Steve Dow. All other study treatment, bloodwork and tests covered; owners pay initial cancer diagnoses and exam at every visit, up to $2,000 in study side-effect care.

Biopsy confirmed canine bladder TCC; mandatory fractionated radiation with daily anesthesia and NSAID tolerance. Radiation six week and chemo two week washout; CSU Fort Collins. Study covers lapatinib, tests/in-study visits and $3,000 toward radiation; owner pays initial testing including biopsy, NSAID and remaining radiation. Megan Gutwillig.

Confirmed biopsy-accessible STS, ≥11 kg, no treatment within two weeks or prior immunotherapy. CSU Dan Regan, Fort Collins. Up to $3,200 in study costs, $2,000 toward surgery and up to $500 for adverse effects; owner pays screening, excess surgical costs and drug dispensing. Do not infer CSU is an extra Tufts/UC Davis site solely by overlapping CAR-T platform and investigators.

CSU MRI-confirmed canine glioma, >10 lb, no prior chemotherapy or radiation, fit for anesthesia; mandatory verdinexor with two CAR-T infusions and RT available per description. Study covers funded treatment, MRIs, study labs and lifetime verdinexor. Breonna Kusick. Published study end December 31, 2028 already canonical.

Separate CSU nonsurgical oral verdinexor cohort, MRI confirmed brain tumor ≥10 kg and no major illness, no prior chemo or RT for this tumor. Owners pay $700 once for chemotherapy, exams/bloodwork/follow-up MRI covered. Breonna Kusick. Not CAR-T IACUC 5335.

CSU confirmed measurable/sampleable TVT lesion strictly >1 cm, fit for anesthesia, no prior primary-tumor surgery, systemic chemo or RT; no advanced spread and seven day immunosuppressant washout. Owner pays examination and confirmation before enrollment; study pays pretreatment labs/imaging as needed and all RT/rechecks, with $1,000 chemotherapy credit for persistent or progressive tumor. No public cutoff.

CSU-coordinated, local oncology care without travel to Fort Collins required. Confirmed AML with circulating cells; reasonable activity and organ health, no other current anticancer therapy or incomplete washout. Funded trametinib, prednisone, study diagnostic monitoring and shipping; initial diagnosis and unrelated care not promised. Adam Harris. Existing study-end-derived cutoff March 31, 2028.

Exact CAALM Davis, oral melanoma only with lung metastasis and >15 <36 kg, life expectancy >4 weeks, prior checkpoint blockade excluded, chemotherapy/immunotherapy/steroids two week washout. Required treatment and study testing plus $2,000 for adverse effects; owner pays pre-enrollment costs. VCCT. Existing study-end-derived cutoff September 10, 2027; earlier general announcement does not broaden current tumor types.

Exact Davis CARE, suspected high grade glioma on MRI, standard RT planned, fit for anesthesia and repeated visits, BAQ-13 and two biopsies. Initial diagnostics owner-paid, study testing/drug/study hospitalization covered; $4,000 toward RT at completion and up to $3,000 toward UC Davis VMTH study complication care. VCCT. Existing January 4, 2028 cutoff.

Exact Davis PRISM, MRI presumed high-grade glioma, palliative or fractionated RT pathway and fit for anesthesia/repeats with biopsy. Catalog represents only treatment-access RT arm; $3,000 toward ongoing treatment, diagnostics and treatment otherwise owner responsibility. VCCT. Existing August 13, 2031 cutoff.

Davis Culp, confirmed canine nasal tumor, chemo plus scheduled RT, return at four weeks for second CT. Study covers CTs, chemotherapy administration and part of RT, no fixed owner price published. This is separate from nasal TAE and it requires willingness for RT.

Davis Culp exact naturally occurring canine nasal cancer; CT checks for adjacent invasion, explicitly may prevent enrollment. Study covers two PET/CT scans and anesthesia. Owner pays TAE and complication treatment, also initial CT if ineligible. Academic public enrollment route; no end date posted.
